text: nina: quick FYI noticed DE translation of 'routing-policy' lost the dash in the anchor. EN uses #routing-policy but DE is #routingpolicy so product links jump to the top. anyone own de/guides/routing? leo: can you paste the exact links? i can repro locally. nina: en: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/routing#routing-policy de: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/de/guides/routing#routingpolicy l10n-bot: linkcheck: fragment mismatch detected for /de/guides/routing (referrer: /guides/routing). first seen 2026-01-14. hannah: loc team usually owns de pages. small anchor alias is safe. @kevin do you want to own the localization PR? kevin: I can take it. prefer to avoid changing EN anchors since other pages reference them. plan: add hidden anchor `` above the Policy heading in the DE file and add a one-line curl smoke in docs-smoke. leo: +1. please include l10n ticket id in the PR and tag @docs-ci for the smoke test addition. kevin: local test I used before opening PR: ```bash # add alias anchor before heading awk '/^#+ Routing Policy/{print ""}1' de/guides/routing.md > tmp && mv tmp de/guides/routing.md # smoke: ensure fragment resolves (status 200 + final url) curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/de/guides/routing#routing-policy" ``` kevin: PR opened: #4768-de-routing-anchor-alias. requesting review from hannah and nina, cc @docs-ci. added l10n ticket DE-789 in the PR description. hannah: LGTM. docs-ci: please allow the microtest under smoke/quickchecks and keep it gated to changed pages only. docs-ci: noted. will accept a single curl assertion and run it only when de/guides/routing.md is changed. nina: thanks all. i'll add a short KB note under /kb/translation-anchor-drift so translators see recommended anchor patterns (lowercase-dash). :memo:
